{{Top|canon=Ivory (Grand Arena)}}
{{Youmay|the substance|[[Ivory]], the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]}}
'''Ivory''' was a precious substance found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Children">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> that commonly resembled [[Bone/Legends|bone]].<ref name="Ewoks">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> One type of ivory, [[Rock ivory]], could be used for [[Repulsorlift/Legends|anti-gravity]] generators,<ref name="Children" /> and was processed at [[Rock ivory processing plant|plants]] on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].<ref name="Fate">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> Another rare type, [[Chammian ivory]], was used to create valuable items, such as [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s antique wall [[Chronometer/Legends|chrono]].<ref name="The Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> The [[Japor ivory wood|wood]] of the [[japor tree]] resembled ivory,<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]s of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] possessed at least one sacred relic known as the [[Ivory Tooth]].<ref name="Ewoks" />
